info.title: pi-switchboard
info.description: An OpenAI-compatible API over pi: its models, logins and providers. The OpenAI-compatible routes follow OpenAI's schemas; pi-specific data on them sits under `x_pi`. The `/v1/switchboard/` routes are the proxy's own.

tags.name: OpenAI-compatible
tags.description: OpenAI's routes, as the proxy implements them.

tags.name: Operational
tags.description: Health checks, outside the OpenAI-compatible surface. Not shaped like OpenAI.

tags.name: Documentation
tags.description: This document and its docs page.

tags.name: Not supported
tags.description: OpenAI endpoints the proxy does not implement. Each answers 404.

proxyAuth.description: Only when proxy auth is on (`--auth-token`, `PI_SWITCHBOARD_AUTH_TOKEN` or `authToken`); otherwise any or no token is accepted.

NotSupported.description: The endpoint is not supported by this proxy (`invalid_request_error`).

message.description: Fixed text; never quotes the provider.

exposureError.description: Why the exposure config is invalid.

scopeDiagnostics.description: `enabledModels` patterns that matched nothing, matched several providers, or carried an invalid thinking level.

target.description: The canonical ID or family it names, as written; for `family-unparsed`, a member pi has (exposed or hidden) whose version the family rule cannot read.

aliasDiagnostics.description: Aliases and alias targets left out (#66): named like an exposed model (`shadows-model`), set to a reasoning effort the model doesn't support (`effort-unsupported`, #230), following a family no rule knows (`family-unknown`, #231) or pinned outside it (`pin-outside-family`), all of which make the check fail; naming no exposed model (`target-not-exposed`); or a family member whose version the rule can't read (`family-unparsed`, never picked).

provider.description: The base provider: the `routing.logins.order` key, or the provider whose every login is disabled; null for an unknown name in `routing.logins.disabled`.

login.description: The name as written; null for `all-logins-disabled`.

loginDiagnostics.description: `routing.logins` names that are no login of their provider (`unknown-login`, ignored), and providers whose every login is disabled (`all-logins-disabled`): their models are not listed or served (#233). Neither fails the check.

position.description: The target's place in the alias, from 0.

family.description: The family it follows, as written.

pin.description: The canonical ID it is pinned to.

resolved.description: The canonical ID it serves now: the pin, else the newest exposed member.

newerHidden.description: A newer member pi has that the exposure config hides; the alias honours the hiding.

familyAliases.description: What each family alias target resolves to now (#231): its pin, else the newest exposed member, with a newer member the exposure config hides.

model.description: The canonical ID, for a model.

until.description: When it ends, as an ISO 8601 time.

source.description: Whether the failed response gave the time, or the growing default did (60 s, 180 s, then doubling).

cooldowns.description: Active cooldowns after a 429 (the provider) or a 503/529 (the model), soonest end first (#68). They do not fail the check.

modelsJsonError.description: Why `models.json` did not load; a parse error says only where, never what.

error.description: Which check failed; the reason is in the log.

loginsRegistered.description: `false` when pi's credential store could not be listed at startup, so the `{provider}-N` logins were not registered and stay unregistered until the proxy restarts. It does not change `status`.

loginsError.description: With `loginsRegistered: false`: the failure's error code or name (`EACCES`, `TimeoutError`); the message is in the proxy log.

verified.description: Only with `?verify=true`: whether pi resolved a usable credential just now, which may refresh an OAuth token over the network. `error` says why not.

observedAt.description: When the response that reported it arrived, as an ISO 8601 time.

quota.description: The provider's latest subscription quota, from its response headers (#69), or null when it reports none. A window that has reset since is left out.

id.description: The public model ID; may contain `/`.

created.description: Unix time (seconds) the proxy started, the same for every model: not a release date, since pi's catalogue has none. `GET /v1/switchboard/models` has what pi knows per model.

ListModelCapabilitiesResponse.description: Each exposed model, with its capabilities.

reasoning_efforts.description: The `reasoning_effort` values the model runs at as asked, lowest first. Any other value is accepted and clamped to the nearest level the model supports. `["none"]` for a model without reasoning. For an alias whose first target sets its effort, that effort alone.

reasoning_effort_fixed.description: True for an alias whose first target sets its effort (#230): a request's `reasoning_effort` is replaced by the one listed. A fallback chain lists its first target; a later target runs at its own effort, or the request's. False otherwise.

max_output_tokens.description: The most output tokens one response can have.

cost.description: pi's prices, in USD per million tokens: uncached input, output, cache reads and cache writes. 0 where pi has no price.

reason.description: The failure it is cooling down from: a 429, or a 503 or 529.

scope.description: A 429 cools the whole login; an overload, the model.

until.description: When it ends, in Unix seconds.

cooldown.description: The cooldown the model is under (#68), or null. A route that names the reason in its `fallbackOn` skips it until then; one that names neither still calls it.

observed_at.description: When the response that reported it arrived, in Unix seconds.

status.description: The provider's overall status, such as Anthropic's `allowed`.

name.description: The provider's name for the window: `5h`, `7d`, `primary`, `secondary`.

resets_at.description: When it resets, in Unix seconds.

quota.description: The login's latest subscription quota, from its response headers (#69), or null when it reports none (Google, API keys, or no call since the proxy started). A window that has reset since is left out.

availability.description: Whether the provider login serves the model, from calls this process made (#174): `refused` after the login refused it (answered as 404 `model_not_found`), `verified` after a whole answer, `unknown` before either. The latest result wins. An alias reports its target's.

id.description: The login: the provider, or one of its extra logins (`anthropic-2`, #227).

disabled.description: Whether `routing.logins.disabled` names the login (#233): it keeps its credential, but routing never calls it.

reason.description: The failure it is cooling down from: a 429, or a 503 or 529.

scope.description: A 429 cools the whole login; an overload, the model.

until.description: When it ends, in Unix seconds.

cooldown.description: The cooldown the model is under (#68), or null. A route that names the reason in its `fallbackOn` skips it until then; one that names neither still calls it.

observed_at.description: When the response that reported it arrived, in Unix seconds.

status.description: The provider's overall status, such as Anthropic's `allowed`.

name.description: The provider's name for the window: `5h`, `7d`, `primary`, `secondary`.

resets_at.description: When it resets, in Unix seconds.

quota.description: The login's latest subscription quota, from its response headers (#69), or null when it reports none (Google, API keys, or no call since the proxy started). A window that has reset since is left out.

logins.description: The logins that may serve the model, in the order routing tries them (#227), as `routing.logins.order` sets it (#233); then the disabled ones, which it never tries. The model's own `cooldown` and `quota` are the first login's.

ModelCapabilities.description: What pi knows about an exposed model.

left.description: Requests the client left before the answer.

average_first_event_ms.description: Average time to a stream's first event.

input_tokens.description: Uncached input tokens. The prompt is these plus `cache_read_tokens` and `cache_write_tokens`.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the provider's cache.

alias.description: The alias; `null` for requests that named a model directly.

left.description: Requests the client left before the answer.

average_first_event_ms.description: Average time to a stream's first event.

input_tokens.description: Uncached input tokens. The prompt is these plus `cache_read_tokens` and `cache_write_tokens`.

cache_read_tokens.description: Input tokens read from the provider's cache.

cache_write_tokens.description: Input tokens written to the provider's cache.

SwitchboardUsage.description: The stats file's usage over a window.

model.description: The canonical ID, for a model.

until.description: When it ends, as an ISO 8601 time.

source.description: Whether the failed response gave the time, or the growing default did (60 s, 180 s, then doubling).

ClearedCooldowns.description: The cooldowns that were active and are now ended, soonest end first.

logprobs.description: Always `null`: pi returns no token probabilities, and `logprobs` is rejected.

alias.description: The alias the request named (#66); present only when it named one.

login.description: The login that answered (`anthropic`, `anthropic-2`), when the model has more than one (#227); absent otherwise.

reasoning_effort.description: What the request asked for and what the model that answered runs at (#175); present only when the request set `reasoning_effort` or the alias's target sets an effort (#230).

requested.description: The `reasoning_effort` the request sent, or null when it sent none.

applied.description: The effort the proxy asked pi to run the model at: the alias target's when it sets one (#230), else `requested` when the model supports it, else the nearest level it does. pi's adapter may still translate it for the provider.

attempts.description: The models an alias tried before the one that answered, in order, and why each failed (#67); present only when one did.

model.description: The canonical ID of the model.

login.description: The login tried (`anthropic`, `anthropic-2`), when the model has more than one (#227). Absent otherwise.

reasoning_effort.description: The effort the alias's target runs it at (#230), replacing the request's. Absent when the target sets none.

reason.description: Why the chain moved on from it: its failure, the one it is cooling down from, or `quota` when its provider had less than the config's `routing.reserve` left.

skipped.description: Not called: it was cooling down after that failure (#68), or below its quota reserve (#69). Absent when tried.

x_pi.description: Not OpenAI's: pi's cost (USD) and cache token counts, and the alias and fallback attempts that led to the answer.

prompt_tokens.description: The whole prompt: uncached, cache reads and cache writes.

cache_write_tokens.description: Not OpenAI's: prompt tokens written to the cache.

id.description: The request ID, the same in every chunk.

arguments.description: The next piece of JSON text.

choices.description: Empty in the final usage chunk.

usage.description: Only in the final chunk, and only with `stream_options.include_usage`.

x_pi.description: Not OpenAI's: in every chunk, only when the request named an alias or an alias fell back (#67).

login.description: The login that answered (`anthropic`, `anthropic-2`), when the model has more than one (#227); absent otherwise.

reasoning_effort.description: What the request asked for and what the model that answered runs at (#175); present only when the request set `reasoning_effort` or the alias's target sets an effort (#230).

requested.description: The `reasoning_effort` the request sent, or null when it sent none.

applied.description: The effort the proxy asked pi to run the model at: the alias target's when it sets one (#230), else `requested` when the model supports it, else the nearest level it does. pi's adapter may still translate it for the provider.

attempts.description: The models an alias tried before the one that answered, in order, and why each failed (#67); present only when one did.

model.description: The canonical ID of the model.

login.description: The login tried (`anthropic`, `anthropic-2`), when the model has more than one (#227). Absent otherwise.

reasoning_effort.description: The effort the alias's target runs it at (#230), replacing the request's. Absent when the target sets none.

reason.description: Why the chain moved on from it: its failure, the one it is cooling down from, or `quota` when its provider had less than the config's `routing.reserve` left.

skipped.description: Not called: it was cooling down after that failure (#68), or below its quota reserve (#69). Absent when tried.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One `data:` event of a streamed completion.

model.description: The canonical ID of the model that answered.

encrypted_content.description: With `include: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"]`: the token that replays this reasoning to the model that produced it, when sent back in `input`. base64url JSON, not encrypted by the proxy: the thinking text is readable in it.

x_pi.description: Not OpenAI's: pi's cost and cache counts, and the route, as on chat completions.

ResponseStreamEvent.description: One event of a streamed response.

get.description: Built from the routes; committed as `openapi.json`. Needs no token.

get.summary: The Swagger UI page for this document
get.description: Only when `docsUi` is on (`--docs-ui`, `PI_SWITCHBOARD_DOCS_UI`); it loads Swagger UI from the jsDelivr CDN. Needs no token: a browser cannot send one to open it.
Answers once the proxy listens and pi's model runtime is loaded. No upstream calls, and no token needed: for container healthchecks.

get.summary: The model runtime and the exposure it gives

200.description: At least one model is exposed.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

503.description: No model is exposed or the exposure config is invalid (the same report), or the check threw.

get.description: Local state only, unless `verify=true` asks pi to resolve each credential now, which may refresh an OAuth token over the network. Never returns a credential.

200.description: Every provider has a credential, verified when asked.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

503.description: No provider has a credential, or a verified one failed (the same report), or the check threw.

parameters.name: verify
parameters.description: `true` asks pi to resolve each credential now.

get.description: The models the exposure config exposes that have a credential, as standard OpenAI model objects with their public IDs.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

get.summary: List each exposed model's pi capabilities
get.description: Not OpenAI's: what pi knows about each model `GET /v1/models` lists, such as the `reasoning_effort` values it runs at as asked.

200.description: Each exposed model, with its capabilities.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

get.summary: Usage over a window, from the stats file
get.description: Not OpenAI's: requests, timings, attempts, tokens and cost per served model and per alias, failures by class, rejected requests by status, and a timeline, from the stats the proxy keeps. Routes and counts only: never message content, `user` or a credential.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

503.description: Stats are off (`--no-stats`), or the stats file could not be read (`stats_unavailable`).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: `today` (from local midnight; the default), `week` (the last 7 days) or `all` (the last 30 days, all the stats file keeps).

delete.description: Not OpenAI's (#182): ends the cooldowns a 429, 503 or 529 started, so a fallback chain calls those models again at once. No query ends every one; `provider` ends a login's, `model` a model's own, and both end both. The next failure without a time waits 60 s again.

200.description: The cooldowns ended; empty when none was active.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

404.description: No login by the `provider` ID serves an exposed model or is cooling down (`login_not_found`), or no model by the `model` ID is exposed or cooling down (`model_not_found`).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: A login's provider ID, such as `anthropic-2`: ends its cooldown after a 429.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A model's canonical or public ID: ends the model's own cooldown after a 503 or 529, not its logins'. A 429 cools the login, not the model: end it with `provider`, as `model` alone then answers an empty list.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

404.description: No exposed model has this ID (`model_not_found`).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: A public model ID, or a canonical `provider/model-id` of an exposed model. IDs may contain `/`: send it URL-encoded (`%2F`) or as is.

post.description: Runs the request on the model through pi. Unsupported fields are rejected, not ignored: 422 for a field the proxy does not accept, 400 for an invalid value.

200.description: With `stream` false or absent, one JSON completion. With `stream: true`, server-sent events: each `data:` line is a chunk; a failure after the stream started is one `data:` line with an error body; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

400.description: Invalid JSON, an invalid field value or message, a conversation longer than the model takes (`context_length_exceeded`), a request the provider refused as invalid (`upstream_invalid_request`), the old `X-Pi-Upstream-Api-Key` header, or an empty `X-Switchboard-Upstream-Api-Key`.

401.description: Proxy auth failed, or the provider rejected the key sent in `X-Switchboard-Upstream-Api-Key` (`upstream_api_key_invalid`).

404.description: No exposed model has this ID, or the provider refused the model for the login the proxy uses (`model_not_found`).

413.description: The body is over the size limit.

422.description: A field the proxy does not accept (`unsupported_parameter`).

502.description: The provider refused pi's stored credential (`upstream_auth_error`), pi has no credential for the model's provider and no `X-Switchboard-Upstream-Api-Key` was sent (`upstream_credentials_missing`), or the provider failed.

503.description: The provider is unavailable or overloaded.

504.description: The provider timed out, or sent nothing for the upstream timeout.

parameters.name: x-switchboard-upstream-api-key
parameters.description: An API key for the model's provider, used instead of pi's stored credential for this request. Empty or only spaces is refused with 400; leave the header out to use the stored credential. Before the rename it was `X-Pi-Upstream-Api-Key`, which is now rejected with 400.

post.description: OpenAI's Responses API, stateless: off unless `responsesApi` is on. Runs as chat completions do, with function tools only and nothing stored. Unsupported fields are rejected, not ignored: 422 for a field the proxy does not accept, 400 for an invalid value.

200.description: With `stream` false or absent, one `response` object. With `stream: true`, server-sent `response.*` events, ending with `response.completed`, `response.incomplete` or `response.failed`.

400.description: Invalid JSON, an invalid field value, a reasoning `encrypted_content` this proxy did not write, or the errors chat completions give.

401.description: Proxy auth is on and the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header is missing or wrong.

404.description: The Responses API is off, or no exposed model has this ID.

422.description: A field the proxy does not accept (`unsupported_parameter`): stored state (`previous_response_id`, `conversation`, `background`, `prompt`, `store: true`), a tool that is not a function, and the others listed in docs/api.md.

parameters.name: x-switchboard-upstream-api-key
parameters.description: An API key for the model's provider, used instead of pi's stored credential for this request. Empty or only spaces is refused with 400; leave the header out to use the stored credential. Before the rename it was `X-Pi-Upstream-Api-Key`, which is now rejected with 400.
